nom: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser

avis.texte: I absolutely love this wash. Anytime I need a quick skin reset, I grab use this. It's gentle. My skin always feels refreshed afterwards but never tight. It has been added to my facial wash rotation.

My skin and the city I live in, I do get pimples and pollution on constant attack mode. This cleanser is my fav along with the soybean. On days my skin has been little beating I use this when my skin is more calm I'll use my birch cleanser. Much recommend for any redness and
This stuff is fantastic. Within a week, a patch of skin that was irritated had greatly calmed down.

I got this cleanser with the hope it would be a gentle cleanser for acne prone skin. It unfortunately just really dried me out. I'd say my skin errs on the oily side and I'm not sensitive so it was a bit of surprise for me. I would just be aware that it could dry your skin more than you want.

I recently got this line for my brother who was having a really hard time with his acne- it was madly inflamed, irritated, breaking out all over the place. This line has been a lifesaver. Works so well with him.

I've used the ampuole, toner, and toner pads from this line and loved those products so was really excited to try this cleanser. But it always left this weird film on my skin. Similar feeling to when you use old school bar soap on your body. I feel like it made my perioral dermatitis worst and not very moisturizing. Really disappointed.
Recommended for redness. This painful and so drying on my skin. I would have loved this when i was a teen still scrubbing my skin with alcohol pads and stridex. Not for roscea or redness.

Seemed nice at first, but when rinsing it off, it left behind a very odd residue, similarly to when you use a very stripping bar soap. I tried it on my hands and, when rinsing it off, I saw the water acting as if there was a thin film on top of my skin. I washed my hands with my usual cleanser, and the film went away, leaving my skin feeling much cleaner.
I found this product to be a bit irritating as someone with sensitive skin. It works wonders on my siblings face who has oily skin

avis.titre: Had high hopes but was disappointed
avis.texte: After reading other reviews, I was really excited to give this a shot especially bc I hear good things about round lab in general. I received this, the patch test went well and had no reaction. I tried it the next day and by the end of the day, I had two painful pimples on my forehead - the one place I rarely if EVER break out. It was also very stripping. Did have a pleasant scent and good lather but that's the only good things aby it Unfortunately returning this cleanser. For reference I have combination skin (oily t zone, dry cheeks) and sensitive skin
This is the first cleanser I've used that made my skin feel truly clean. Other cleansers did not remove all makeup and oil but this one did. I love it and will buy it again.
I bought this on a whim due to a sale, but I will definitely repurchase. I have never been let down by a Round Lab cleanser. I love them all.

I have dry skin and this cleanser leaves my face feeling super soft fresh and hydrated. For me it doesn't feel stripping or cause any irritation. I've been really happy with it. This will be my go to!
After watching your face, all of the oils on your face are stripped away. Your face feels tight and dry. If you like that feeling, I would recommend using a normal soup bar.
I use this product as my second cleanser and I absolutely LOVE IT
A product that adapts to you skin type. It cleans but also leave your skin nice and refreshing.
I was surprised at how well this cleanses my skin, especially when it comes to removing sebaceous filaments.

avis.titre: A blessing for acne prone skin!
avis.texte: If you have skin that is easily irritated, as well as acne prone I highly recommend this cleanser! Cleanses well without drying the skin and doesn't irritate sensitive skin. Although if you do tend to get seasonal allergies from trees and stuff I might be weary just in case of an allergic reaction.
Best face wash ever. It makes your skin feel squeaky clean in a good way without making your skin feel dry.

This cleanser is a skincare game-changer! Its gentle yet effective formula revitalizes my skin, leaving it refreshed without losing moisture. The subtle, soothing scent is a calming delight, perfect after a long day. The quality stands out - carefully selected ingredients create a luxurious, skin-improving experience. It's become a staple in my routine, offering both skincare care and a pleasant sensory experience. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a high-quality, skin-loving cleanser!
Love this foaming cleanser. This is my third time repurchasing. A little goes a long way! It lathers so beautifully.

My skin gets really red and irritated rather easily so whenever my face is having ~one of THOSE~ days I wash with this cleanser! I switch out between this one and the Dokdo cleanser and my skin has never looked better!

I'm using various cleansing foams, and this foam lathers well, cleans my face cleanly, and most of all, it doesn't feel tight after washing my face and makes my skin feel comfortable. Other than that, it doesn't really feel like it's been cleaned cleanly, but it's nice and gentle even though it wipes cleanly.

I have the pine cleanser, toner, ampoule, and cream. I wasn't sure how much of a difference they were making until I missed a night of skincare and my redness returned with full force by the morning. I will live and die with this product on my face.

My favourite cleanser ever. It doesn't strip my skin but it still cleans very well. It foams up very easily and it smells good (it doesn't have fragrance btw!) My skin feels hydrated afterwards and i noticed it helps with my redness. I recommend especially if you have oily/combo skin. Its very soothing so sensitive skin can also use it, there is salicylic acid in it though. I personally have combo sensitive skin and i had no problems with it

I have combo-oily skin and it does a good job of cleansing and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean without stripping the skin. I mainly use it in the evening though due to it being slightly alkaline.
Round lab is the best i love it i used cica for my skin and this one is quite good

avis.titre: This is my favourite foam cleanser!
avis.texte: This is my favourite foam cleanser! You need so little and it lathers so luxuriously. I will keep repurchasing

I feel like it suits my skin even better! It has a slightly more creamy texture, but it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or dry. I think it would be perfect for people with oily or combination skin, except for those with extremely dry skin...! I only bought one bottle, but I'm regretting not buying more!
I'm happy with it because it has gentle ingredients, and I generally like Round Lab's skincare products!

avis.titre: Changed my skin for the better
avis.texte: Last year, I struggled a lot with sudden adult acne, and no matter what products I used, my skin didn't seem to improve. However, when I switched my skincare routine to the Pine Cica Line, my skin improved significantly!

I'm using all the products from the "Pine Cica Line" and I'm extremely satisfied with them. When the new "Pine Cleanser" was released, I immediately purchased it because I was looking for a slightly alkaline cleanser. The texture is really smooth, and it lathers up nicely with rich foam.
After cleansing, it leaves my skin feeling non-sticky and firm, which I love, so I use it daily. It also soothes my skin and has great cleansing power!

At first, I was intrigued by its appearance, as it looked somewhat like a lotion, but the foam it produced was surprisingly rich and dense. I was satisfied with that. Also, a YouTuber mentioned that it leaves a refreshing finish, and I can confirm that it indeed leaves a refreshing feeling on my skin

avis.titre: Feels very nice on my skin
avis.texte: I think I can trust and use the Pine Line without any worries now! I decided to try out the new foam cleanser that was recently released, and I'm extremely satisfied with it. It cleanses my skin effectively without causing any irritation, and it leaves my skin feeling moisturized and refreshed. I'm really happy with this product and will continue using it!
I'm managing my face and body with the Pine line, and personally, I would love it if they also release a slightly acidic cleanser and a refreshing and moisturizing Pine Body Lotion

When I rinse my face with water, it doesn't leave any stickiness. I have combination skin, and when my T- zone gets oily, I use a slightly alkaline cleanser, but when my skin is not oily, I prefer using a slightly acidic one. Now that the Pine Cleanser is available, I think I'll stick to it.

I used to use a lot of cleansing oil, but I switched to this product due to acne concerns, and it has a calming effect on my small pimples. It's really great. It doesn't leave my skin dry either. There's nothing better for sensitive and acne-prone skin

My favourite cleanser ever. I need to buy backups! A little goes a long way so I don't go through it as often as other cleansers which is great. Cleans face without stripping the skin and the foam is so soft and luxurious.

It cleanses really well, leaving a refreshing feeling without drying out my skin. It's amazing! Feels like I've found my holy grail cleansing foam! I can even use it in the morning without any worries!

I happened to run out of cleansing foam, so I purchased this product that I had put in my cart. My skin type is oily, acne-prone, and tends to have excess sebum and dead skin cells, especially during the changing seasons. First of all, I was satisfied with the fast shipping, and I think this product is suitable for those with combination skin during the summer. It's a refreshing foam that effectively removes excess oil, and it lathers up nicely.
My impression after using this product was genuinely surprising. Even though my skin is sensitive and tends to get irritated easily, it felt incredibly comfortable.

As expected from a mildly alkaline cleanser, it had excellent cleansing power. The foam was just right, not too excessive, and it felt so smooth that I had to be gentle while washing. Overall, I was very satisfied with the initial results

I was already using the Pine Calming Ampoule, Mask Pack, and Cream and loving them, so when I heard they released a foam cleanser, I couldn't resist and bought it immediately. Let me tell you, it's amazing! There's nothing like it. I highly recommend the entire Pine Calming line
When I feel like my face is getting too oily, I use this cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling so clean and refreshed. I think it also helps prevent breakouts, and I really like using it.

I used to only use acidic cleansers, but I felt like they didn't completely clean my face, so I heard that using a mild alkaline cleanser 2-3 times a week could be beneficial. So, I decided to give it a try, and I wish I had tried it sooner! It really lathers well and leaves my skin feeling so refreshed and clean. Since it's part of the Pine Calming Cica line, I didn't experience any irritation either. I use it in the evening, and it's so refreshing!
Using the mildly alkaline foam cleanser twice a week really helps with controlling sebum and reducing those pesky small pimples. I'm loving it!

avis.titre: I think I found my permanent foam cleanser.
avis.texte: I think I found my permanent foam cleanser. I've used the toner pad, moisturizer, and ampoule that's in the same line as this cleanser and really liked those products. The satisfaction I felt from those products can be felt with this. The soothing ingredients are definitely there and help make the cleanser feel gentle for sensitive skin. The scent is also similarly very subtle.
